author: PC Gamer
text:
Jagex partnered with a RuneScape-inspired idle game to turn the sequel into an official spinoff
Melvor Idle 2 has gained a subtitle: A RuneScape Adventure.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 teased a handful of its upcoming radio stations and its music curation is as strong as ever
I can already picture my late-night Leonida drives to these bangers.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GOG wants to bring back physical games, but it's 'a very, very complicated thing'
"You click on the game that you would like to receive a physical copy of, you order it, and it gets to you. That would be a perfect scenario."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve's long-lost prototype Portal prequel appears online after nearly 20 years
F-Stop was a result of a post-Orange Box, 2007 Valve game jam.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Composer and designer Lena Raine explains how Pigstep altered Minecraft's approach to music: 'The prompt I keep hearing is "Oh, Pigstep was such a banger that they want more bangers"'
The composer for Celeste and Minecraft guides us through the games on her PC.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'An absolute behemoth': Wildly ambitious FPS Selaco is getting a massive update that doubles its size and adds 'a heavy machinegun that fires literal explosions'
Selaco: The Machines of War arrives later this month.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Chronicles: Medieval developer faces imminent closure after losing funding: 'What makes it hurt is how close we are. Early access is in reach'
But the studio says it is "not going down without a fight".

author: PC Gamer
text:
It's not just Steam: New game pages created per day on Itch.io have doubled in the last two months, with AI slop the likely culprit
"The number of downloads and purchases has *not* doubled."

author: PC Gamer
text:
I'm glad that WoW: Forever'll have a slower, lo-fi update schedule, because I'm not playing this thing to be in a rush
I tire of seasons.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Forza co-creator Dan Greenawalt is reportedly leaving Microsoft
Another nail in Motorsport's coffin.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After almost a decade of work, Alien: Isolation mod tools hit 1.0 with support for 'full custom maps, missions, modes, characters, weapons, animations, sounds, models, textures, and more'
Structural perfection.

author: PC Gamer
text:
FromSoftware temporarily shuts down Dark Souls 2 and 3 multiplayer over 'server issue'
The reason and timeline for restoration were not disclosed.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fanfiction Library of Alexandria AO3 down for up to a month following hack
Just uncalled-for.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Elder Scrolls Skyblivion mod faces lawsuit from former volunteer, project lead urges 'Please don't turn this into any kind of witch hunt'
The volunteer team is seeking pro bono legal aid.
